snippet.title: Clomid: How Many Cycles Is Too Many? #Shorts
snippet.description:
How long should you keep trying Clomid (clomiphene)? The French prescribing information sets a maximum of six treatment cycles, and if three courses at the recommended dose do not produce ovulation, the trial is considered over. If ovulation happens but there is still no pregnancy after several tries, the workup and the strategy are reviewed.

Full video: https://youtu.be/e3U7UdalWJs

Source: French prescribing information for clomiphene (ANSM, SmPC), section 4.2: https://base-donnees-publique.medicaments.gouv.fr/medicament/65338028/extrait

Dr Senai Aksoy, Associate Professor of Reproductive Medicine. This video is for education and information only. It is not personal medical advice, a diagnosis or a treatment recommendation. Do not start, stop or change medication based on this video without consulting your doctor.

This is an English-dubbed version of Dr Aksoy's original French educational video, using an AI voice based on Dr Aksoy's own voice. Lip movements were adjusted with AI to match the English audio. Humorous clips are illustrations and are labeled on screen.
